title: Dusty's Treasure Hunt
subtitle: Three hidden keys in The Rust Kingdom, Burning Springs

sections.title: How to Start the Hunt
sections.html:
There's no quest to start. Pick up the note Dusty's Treasure Hunt: it can be in any one of 4 spots around The Rust Kingdom (see Maps at the bottom). Picking up more than one copy doesn't add anything.

Dusty's Treasure Hunt

The Boss says we got to start making space in the storage house; that means throwing stuff out.

Thing is though, I'm not one for charity. If you want something, you gotta work for it!

I've hidden 3 keys all around the kingdom. If you find a key, you get to keep whatever's behind the door. Simple and easy.

Good luck!

sections.title: Dusty's Treasure Hunt Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Find Dusty's Key 1 on the roof

Fast travel to The Rust Kingdom and run south towards the Deathclaw gate. Stop at the fire barrel on your left, face east and jump onto the ramp behind it. Turn south and follow the ramp up to the wall, then turn east and jump up onto the roof above you. Walk south to the edge of the roof and look left: the key hangs from one of the roof spikes.

Step 2 – Find Dusty's Key 2 on the skeleton

From the key 1 roof, face west and jump across to the next roof. Walk south to the end and drop to the ground, then face west and follow the road to its end. At the bottom of the stairs turn south, keep following the road through the gates and stop by the fire truck. Face east and walk slowly: on your left the metal walls have been blown outwards. Go through the gap, keep left round the back of the pipe tower, slip through the gap between the pipes and follow the path to the end. The key is on the skeleton's shoulder.

Step 3 – Find Dusty's Key 3 in the Brahmin cage

Head back out to the fire truck and climb on top of it. Face east and stay on the road; you'll probably need to open two blue wooden gates. Past the second gate, three Abrax metal barrels sit on a pallet ahead of you. Turn south to the cage with a Brahmin corpse inside, step in and look up: the key hangs from the roof.

Step 4 – Get into the storage room

Fast travel to The Rust Kingdom and take the same route up to the key 1 roof. From its southern edge, face east and follow the roofline to the next metal building, then turn south to the edge again. Across from you, slightly right, is a brick building: get onto its roof (a run-up with a jetpack works, or drop down and climb up the far side). Follow that roof south, drop onto the catwalk below, face west and take a few steps: the white door on your right is the storage room.

Step 5 – Open the three doors

Inside are three locked doors, one for each of Dusty's keys. Each key opens its own door, and you keep whatever's behind it (see Rewards). Look out for a note on the floor nearby: it explains why the cages aren't as full as Dusty planned.

Hey Dusty

Hey Dusty,

When you read this, give Sam and Bran a holler. The boss wants us to get a little 'extra ordinance' when heading back to Checkpoint Canyon. Apparently, the freaks across the water have rebuilt the bridge and she's got a job to do, so we might need the extra damage.

Barry

PS

If you're only just reading this and noticed the guns are gone, we got Danny to picklock the doors. You got to lay off the Day-Tripper, man. That shit's gonna get you in trouble with the King.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
Each key opens one locked door in the storage room. What's behind each door:

DoorBehind it
Dusty's Key 12× Safe (locked): safe loot
Suitcase: armour
Dusty's Key 2Locker: locker loot (can be empty)
Pre-War Locker: a small loot roll (can be empty)
Duffle Bag: pre-war money
Duffle Bag: weapons
Dusty's Key 3Toolbox: tools and junk (can be empty)
Chem Cooler: chems

These are loot rolls, so what you get changes each time.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I need lockpicking?

Not for the doors: each one only needs its key. The two safes behind door 1 are locked, so bring lockpicking for those.

Do I have to find the keys in order?

No. Each key only opens its own door, so you can collect and use them in any order.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it.
